sites.name: GGPoker

files.source: Observed on a macOS install, 2026-10-13: GGPoker.app (bundle com.nsuslab.ncf.launcher.live.ggpcom, launcher 1.0, game module 1.0.0.480). No hand-history file anywhere in its data folders (~/Library/Application Support/GGPCOM and com.nsuslab.ncf.launcher.live.ggpcom: UI assets, caches and a few-kilobyte settings databases), ~/Library or ~/Documents; its preferences name no hand-history folder. The glob is the file names of the PokerCraft downloads in gg-hh/.
files.notes: Hands are downloaded afterwards from PokerCraft, not written while playing, and saved wherever the user puts the download - so there is no default folder (paths stay empty: a verified negative, macOS). The in-repo files (gg-hh/) are such downloads, named GG<date>-<time> - <table> - <sb> - <bb> - <n>max.txt. The Windows client was not looked at.

hud.notes: Starting point: likely prohibited (README section 6); import only whatever the policy says, since files are not live and opponents are hashed.

sites.notes: Natural8, BestPoker and ClubGG are GG skins with no real sample (docs/unsupported-formats.md); they get entries of their own once a file confirms the grammar.

files.source: Observed on a macOS install, 2026-10-13: CoinPoker.app 1.25.0 (bundle com.coinpoker.desktopapprelease; an Electron lobby with a Unity table client). Tables had been played (per-table client logs in ~/Library/Logs/CoinPoker), yet no hand-history file exists in its data folders (~/Library/Application Support/CoinPoker, com.CoinPoker.CoinPoker), ~/Library/Logs/CoinPoker (client diagnostics, no hand header in any of them) or ~/Documents; its preferences name no hand-history folder. The client fetches hand history from its server and shows it in the app.
files.notes: No local hand histories on macOS with the client as installed (a verified negative: no path, no glob). Whether a setting in the client's screens turns on a local export was not looked for; the corpus came from a third party's HUD logs (docs/research/hh-formats/coinpoker.md section 12). The Windows client was not looked at.
